title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Unveils New Look At Beloved Characters For Its Next Project
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is one of the biggest fantasy anime of the decade, and it’s all set for its return with its third season next year. Fans are already hyped up about the upcoming season since it will adapt the best manga arc so far.
author: ComicBook

title: Haikyu Reveals Big 2027 With Final Movie And Television Special Previews
content: When it comes to sports anime, the medium has given anime enthusiasts plenty of options that span various competitions of strength and skill. Hajime no Ippo covers boxing, Slam Dunk covers basketball, and Blue Lock covers soccer, though when it comes to volleyball, there is one franchise that rules them all.

title: One Piece Takes a Surprise Hiatus Amid Its Biggest Fight in 29 Years
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the One Piece manga! The highly anticipated Elbaph Arc in One Piece takes a turn for the worse after the unexpected arrival of the Holy Knights and Saint Nerona Imu.

title: Haikyu!! Day 2026 Recap: Movie 2 and Special Anime Teasers, New Manga Remix, More Announcements
content: The Haikyu!! RECEPTION #3 program featured several announcements for Haikyu!! Day on August 19, led by new information for Haikyu the Movie: VS The Little Giant and the special anime Haikyu!! Where the Monsters Go . Both are set to release in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Haikyu the Movie: VS The Little Giant New Visual Highlights Hinata and Hoshiumi
content: Haikyu the Movie: VS The Little Giant (Movie 2) revealed a new concept visual, highlight Hinata and Hoshiumi. The film is set to premiere in Japan in April 2027. Haikyu!! Where the Monsters Go ( Fukurodani vs Mujinazaka ) also shared a visual and trailer. The announcement was made during the third Haikyu!!

title: 'Liar Game' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Shinobu Kaitani 's Liar Game manga announced additional cast on Tuesday. The anime series premiered on April 7 at 12.00 a.m. on TV Tokyo, followed by BS TV Tokyo.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Tempal: Item no Chikara' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Saenal Park and Team Argo 's Tempal: Item no Chikara ( Overgeared ) webtoon revealed additional cast, a second key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and second promotional video on Wednesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Oveageared Anime Reveals Second Trailer, New Key Visual, Cast, October 2 Premiere
content: The upcoming Overgeared anime has revealed its second full trailer, a new key visual, and six additional cast members ahead of its October 2 premiere. Crunchyroll previously confirmed that it would stream the anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Dark Machine: The Animation' Unveils Additional Cast, Opening Theme, Second Promo for Fall 2026
content: The official website for the Dark Machine: The Animation television anime revealed additional cast members, opening theme, and a second promotional video on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere in October 2026 at 1:45 a.m. on Fuji TV, followed by Kansai TV and BS Fuji.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Dark Machine The Animation Series' New Video Reveals More Cast, Opening Song, October TV Debut
